description: This file defines the class CameraCaptureManager, which manages camera device interactions, including listing devices, taking photos, video recording (clips), and permission handling within an Android app using CameraX library. It handles camera permissions, device info retrieval, image capture with EXIF rotation, video recording with configurable options, and utility functions for camera device selection and bitmap processing.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager
classes.description: A class that manages camera operations such as listing devices, capturing photos, recording videos (clips), and permission handling within an Android application using CameraX library. It provides functions for attaching lifecycle and permission requesters, taking photos with EXIF-based rotation, recording video clips with configurable duration and audio, and retrieving camera device info.

methods.name: attachLifecycleOwner
methods.description: Associates a LifecycleOwner with the camera manager to control camera lifecycle.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a PermissionRequester to handle permission requests.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices with their info.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo using the camera with optional parameters, returns a Payload containing the image in base64 along with metadata.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a short video clip with optional audio, duration, and device parameters, returning a FilePayload with recorded file info.
